Despite a gritty effort from Dan Hurley's squad, UConn couldn't overcome a stifling Michigan defense in Monday's national championship game.The Wolverines traded their usual high-powered offensive fireworks for championship-level grit, winning a defensive slugfest by a final score of 69-63. While Michigan had cruised through the 2026 NCAA Tournament with record-breaking point totals, it was the team's interior presence and late-game execution that finally delivered the program its second national title. MORE: Best Highlights From Michigan's Win Over UConnFor UConn, the night will be remembered for a staggering shooting drought that saw the Huskies miss 11 consecutive 3-pointers during a critical stretch of the second half.
